answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Dietitian registration with patient consultation history is the check: consultations logged under one registration for years. A farm faking 294 aliases needs 294 separate consultation histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the kernel signal is public, the knoll check is automatic, and 294 aliases cost 294 times what one real agent costs, with the wander trail open to all.
